label: Before / After Wipe
description: Two full-bleed layers -- the old way and the new way -- and a divider that sweeps across and rests at a split, a knob on the line and a label on each side. Layers are images (screenshots, photos: before_src / after_src) or statements (before_text on a muted grey ground vs after_text on the brand ground). Script the divider with sweeps.

before_text.label: Before statement (used when there is no image), e.g. '14 tabs, 6 tools'

before_label.label: Chip on the before side (default 'Before'; '' hides)

after_label.label: Chip on the after side (default 'After'; '' hides)

split.label: Where the divider rests, 0..1 from the before edge (default 0.5)

sweep_at.label: Seconds the sweep starts (default just after entry)

sweeps.label: Script the divider: [{at, to (0..1), duration}] -- overrides the default reveal-then-settle

bleed.label: Fill the slot edge to edge (no rounded frame)

at.label: Seconds into the scene it enters (default 0.2)
